events.description: Walking along a downtown sidewalk toward a scaffold-covered intersection, passing parked taxis and a street kiosk.
Turning left at the intersection and continuing along the sidewalk beside moving traffic and a stopped city bus.
Turning into a narrow service lane and walking between buildings, parked vehicles, loading areas, and yellow bollards.
Reaching a major intersection and lingering at the corner while viewing Philadelphia City Hall and passing traffic.
An ambulance with emergency lights passes in front of City Hall.
Crossing the broad street on a marked crosswalk toward the City Hall plaza.
Entering the plaza and walking toward and around a temporary Ferris wheel between City Hall and the neighboring historic building.
Walking beside City Hall while looking up at its ornate exterior, then approaching the John Christian Bullitt statue.
Examining the John Christian Bullitt statue and its inscribed pedestal at close range.
Continuing through the plaza past closed wooden market stalls toward a large evergreen tree and the main City Hall entrance.
Lingering near the entrance plaza and looking between City Hall's facade, the large evergreen tree, barriers, and parked maintenance lifts.
Walking along the barricaded path toward City Hall's large arched gateway.
Passing through the open iron gates and traversing City Hall's grand columned interior arcade and tunnel.
Emerging into the interior courtyard and approaching a decorative carousel surrounded by pedestrians and holiday-market stalls.
Walking around the courtyard while inspecting a rounded tower, upper architecture, trees, and rows of closed wooden stalls.
Circling near the carousel and scanning the surrounding courtyard buildings and market area.
Stopping beside the carousel for close views of its ornate two-level structure and sculpted bird and horse figures.
